# Clay & Air

> Breathwork for men who hold it together. A library of 19 breathing techniques you can run on your own, organised by how you feel, plus workshops and retreats run in person.

Every technique is taught by Ben Holt, learned through Awakened Breath and the 21 Day Breathwork Academy. Dynamic Breathwork and Sonic Neural Breathwork are his own designs. Clay & Air is Don Page's practice; the wording and the arrangement here are his.

## How to pick one

Techniques are tagged by state. The tags in use are: Anxious, Angry, Can't sleep, Under pressure, Wired, Scattered, Breathing shallow, Carrying something, Flat, Before training, Cold.

## Relaxing

Eight breathing techniques that bring the nervous system down: for anxiety, sleep, and staying steady under pressure. Safe to run on your own.

- [Foundational breath](https://clayandair.com/relaxing/foundational-breath): The fastest way down. Base for everything else. 3-10 minutes, sitting or lying. For: Anxious, Angry, Breathing shallow.
- [Box breathing](https://clayandair.com/relaxing/box-breathing): Quiets the mind. Used under pressure. 3-10 minutes, sitting upright. For: Under pressure, Scattered, Angry.
- [Turtle breath](https://clayandair.com/relaxing/turtle-breath): Deep relaxation and sleep. 5-10+ minutes, lying down. For: Can't sleep.
- [Nadi Shodhana](https://clayandair.com/relaxing/nadi-shodhana): Evens out both sides. Settles without sedating. 3-10 minutes, sitting upright. For: Wired, Scattered, Can't sleep.
- [Full-fill](https://clayandair.com/relaxing/full-fill): Stacked breaths and a hold. Goes deeper than one round. 3-10 minutes, sitting or lying. For: Breathing shallow, Anxious, Can't sleep.
- [4·3·6](https://clayandair.com/relaxing/4-3-6): Longer exhale than inhale. When box isn't enough. 5-10+ minutes, sitting or lying. For: Anxious, Under pressure.
- [Cleansing breath](https://clayandair.com/relaxing/cleansing-breath): Golden light in, smoke out. Puts the day down. 5-10 minutes, sitting or lying. For: Anxious, Under pressure, Can't sleep, Carrying something.
- [Qi Gong breathing](https://clayandair.com/relaxing/qi-gong-breathing): Standing, slow, with a travelling picture. 1-5 minutes, standing. For: Wired, Scattered.

## Activating

Ten breathing techniques that wake the body up: for mornings, before training, and shifting a flat day. Come back sharper for it.

- [Priming breath](https://clayandair.com/activating/priming-breath): Wakes the body up. Morning, or before training. 30 reps a set, sitting or standing. For: Flat, Before training.
- [Breath of fire](https://clayandair.com/activating/breath-of-fire): Forceful both ways. Builds heat. 1-5 minutes, sitting upright. For: Flat, Cold, Before training.
- [Buteyko breathing](https://clayandair.com/activating/buteyko-breathing): A held walk. Runs while you are moving. 15-25 steps a round, walking. For: Anxious, Under pressure.
- [Kapalabhati](https://clayandair.com/activating/kapalabhati): Forceful exhale only. Works the stomach. 50 reps or 2-7 minutes, sitting upright. For: Flat.
- [Igniter breath](https://clayandair.com/activating/igniter-breath): Warms you up fast. After cold water, or before training. 30 seconds to 5 minutes, sitting upright. For: Flat, Cold, Before training.
- [Twisting breath](https://clayandair.com/activating/twisting-breath): Twist and exhale hard. Warm-up that works the core. About 10 minutes, sitting or standing. For: Before training, Flat.
- [Heart opening breath](https://clayandair.com/activating/heart-opening-breath): Loud on the exhale. Clears the deck before the day. 10-20 minutes, sitting or standing. For: Carrying something, Angry, Flat.
- [Kundalini Bhastrika](https://clayandair.com/activating/kundalini-bhastrika): Breath of fire, arms overhead. Harder. 30 seconds to 5 minutes, sitting or standing. For: Flat, Before training.
- [Digestion igniter](https://clayandair.com/activating/digestion-igniter): Lion's breath and a stomach vacuum. Standing. 10-15 minutes, standing. For: Flat.
- [Dynamic breathwork](https://clayandair.com/activating/dynamic-breathwork): Forty breaths and holds. The big one in this pillar. About 20 minutes, lying down or sitting. For: Flat, Before training.

## Freedom

Sonic Neural Breathwork, a facilitated ceremony rather than a technique you fit into a lunch break. What it is, what it does, and how to prepare for one.

- [Sonic Neural Breathwork](https://clayandair.com/freedom/sonic-neural): The deep one. A facilitated ceremony. About 2.5 hours, lying down. For: not state tagged.

## Safety

Breath holds and forceful breathing are not for everyone. Anyone with a heart or lung condition, high or low blood pressure, epilepsy, or who is pregnant should talk to a doctor before holding their breath. Never practise these in or near water, or while driving.
